#Lib
```{r}
library(bigrquery)

```

#Obter 2022 a 2023
```{r}
project_id <- 'rj-smtr'

sql_query <- 'SELECT * FROM `rj-smtr.transito.receita_autuacao` WHERE data <= "2025-04-08" order by ano, mes'
```

#Executar
```{r}
results <- bq_project_query(project_id, sql_query) 
df_receita_por_mes <- bq_table_download(results)
```
